headword: {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}

definitions.gloss: surcharge; premium; extra fee added to a base price
definitions.explanation: An additional amount added to the regular fee under specific conditions — late-night hours, holidays, oversized or overweight items, overtime work, peak seasons, and the like. Appears on taxi receipts, delivery invoices, utility bills, and airline tickets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}します→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A surcharge applies to reservations during consecutive holidays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When shipping oversized luggage, a surcharge is charged in addition to the regular fee.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{割増|わりまし}→割増：17087_warimashi⟧ ('adding on a percentage, premium') + ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ ('fee, charge'). Most commonly seen on receipts, fare tables, and terms of service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: a surcharge applies
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a surcharge is incurred
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay a surcharge
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}: late-night surcharge
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}: holiday surcharge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追加料金|ついかりょうきん}→追加料金：22313_tsuikaryoukin⟧: additional fee — for any extra fee, whether percentage-based or flat; broader than {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee, commission — a fee for providing a service (e.g., bank transfer fee)
- ⟦{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}→基本料金：22442_kihonryoukin⟧: base fee — the standard rate before surcharges
- {深夜料金|しんやりょうきん}: late-night rate — a specific kind of {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}

USAGE:
Taxi fares in Japan famously include a 20% ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧{割増料金|わりましりょうきん} between roughly 10 p.m. and 5 a.m., which is a familiar concept to anyone who takes late-night taxis.
